steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen to build the saved draft.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required restriction on adding vendors during event creation.
Apply the requested stage-setting configuration.
A title is required to save the draft and identify it.
Configure the draft as an eRFX RFQ stage.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the draft can be configured.
Add the required line item for a valid saved draft.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Commit a schedule so the draft has a configured event schedule.
Save the eRFX event as an unpublished draft.
Open the Participants control that contains the All Vendors window.
Assert that the participant window title is All Vendors.
Assert that the vendor search field is visible.
Assert that the Invite action is visible.
Assert that the Filters action is visible.
Assert that the Cancel action is visible.
Assert that the Save action is visible.
Assert the Name column is present.
Assert the Vendor Code column is present.
Assert the Email column is present.
Assert the Phone column is present.
Assert the Bids column is present.
Assert the Closed column is present.
Assert the City column is present.
Assert the Tags column is present.
